name: Teronis' Journal
summary: Teronis' Journal follows a scout's search through Ashenvale for a gem tied to a rod he hoped could slow furbolg attacks.

sections.title: A Scout's Final Record
sections.body: Teronis, a longtime friend of Raene Wolfrunner, aided the Sentinels and searched Ashenvale for a gem. He believed it belonged to a rod that could slow the furbolg attacks on his people. Near the shore, aggressive creatures brought his journey to an end. The journal was recovered from his personal effects in remarkably good condition. Its findings about a radiant gem that once formed part of the rod give Astranaar's defenders a trail to follow in his unfinished search.

faq.q: Who did this journal belong to?
faq.answer: Teronis, a night elf and longtime friend of Raene Wolfrunner, owned the journal. He searched Ashenvale for a gem tied to a rod he believed could slow furbolg attacks, but died in the wilds before returning with his findings.
The journal is found among Teronis' belongings after his slain body is discovered in the wilds of Ashenvale, near the shore where local murlocs live.

faq.q: What is the purpose of bringing the journal to Astranaar?
aliases: who do i give the journal to
faq.answer: Returning the journal to Raene Wolfrunner tells Astranaar of Teronis' death and gives the Sentinels his notes to continue his search for the rod he hoped could slow the furbolg attacks.

faq.q: What item was Teronis looking for according to his mission?
faq.answer: Teronis sought a glowing gem, one piece of a rod made by the dead wizard Dartol. His investigation suggested nearby murlocs may have scavenged the artifact.

angles.text: For a night elf, Teronis' journal recalls the danger faced by scouts protecting Ashenvale's ancient woodlands from encroaching corruption.
Taking Teronis' field notes back to Astranaar helps the garrison coordinate relief and recover their fallen scout's remains.
